messages:
Marketplace Ops: FYI: VectorSI reported repeated `amdgpu` oops on our marketplace image built with ROCm 5.7 and driver bundle 5.7.3. Failing on MI300 nodes under long-seq workloads.
Nina R.: saw a spike in `kernel_oops` metric on canary earlier. Repro steps? @VectorSI can you paste logs/sattached trace?
VectorSI: attaching truncated dmesg: 
```
[ 1234.567890] amdgpu: Fatal error: GPU fault (code 0x86) on ring gfx at PC 0x7f8...
[ 1234.567895] amdgpu: GPU reset succeeded, but task killed: python3
```
VectorSI: repro in our lab with 8x MI300, sequence length 48k, batch=1, pinned to 512GB HBM. Happens after ~20 min.
Diego M.: thanks. If it's reproducible on our infra we should pin the marketplace image back to ROCm 5.6 and the last known-good driver 5.6.2. Suggest immediate canary rollback.
Hannah S.: agree. Customer impact: a handful of ML partners using long-context models could see failures. We should prepare a short status note and rollback guide. I'll draft.
Rohit (AMD): thanks for reporting. AMD engineering sees a regression introduced when changing MMU table handling in the 5.7 stack. We're investigating; possible hotfix candidate exists but needs validation. ETA for validated patch: ~48 hours. Could do vendor backport for 5.7 tomorrow if tests pass.
Marketplace Ops: Can we do a quick mitigation: toggle `hw_preempt_disable=1` in kernel cmdline for canary nodes as a temporary workaround?
Diego M.: we tried that internally, it avoided the immediate crash but caused perf regressions. Not safe for production. Rollback is cleaner.
Nina R.: action items: (A) Marketplace -> rollback canary to image: `marketplace-image:2026.03.19-rocm56-driver562`, (B) Eng-infra -> add `amdgpu_oops_count` alert, (C) AMD -> share patch/backport ETA and test matrix, (D) Comms -> customer note + SI outreach. Assigning: Marketplace Ops + Diego + Rohit + Hannah.
Marketplace Ops: initiating rollback now. /cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: starting rollback: `deploy/marketplace-image` -> `image:2026.03.19-rocm56-driver562` ... progress 0% -> 100% :white_check_mark:
Marketplace Ops: rollback complete, canary shows no oops in the last 30m, traffic stable. Monitoring for 2h.
Hannah S.: drafting customer note: "We are aware of GPU kernel faults affecting long-context inference on MI300 with ROCm 5.7. Mitigation: rollback to ROCm 5.6 image (we have rolled canary back for marketplace customers). AMD is working on a patch; we'll share ETA. Contact marketplace-support for assisted rollbacks." Posting to partners channel in 10m.
Diego M.: PR for alert rule: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pull/418 (adds `amdgpu_oops_count > 0` and a runbook).
Rohit (AMD): I'll open a secure SR and post the preliminary patch link in the vendor-only channel once validation completes. Also adding MI300 stress tests to our matrix.
Nina R.: scheduling a vendor sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm backport plan and customer comms. If anyone needs a different time, ping here. Closing this thread for now.
opsbot: scheduled: `vendor-rocm-backport-sync` -> 2026-03-14 16:00 UTC
